name: fanbasis
description: All-in-one marketplace OS for digital products, combining payments, checkout SDKs, subscriptions, funnel builder, and webinars.

evidence.claim: FanBasis provides API credentials, checkout SDKs, and webhook triggers.
FanBasis features an MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration to run from AI assistants.
FanBasis API Docs portal is available at dev-docs.fanbasis.com and apidocs.fan
Community MCP server configuration available on GitHub for connecting AI assistants to FanBasis API.

notes: FanBasis (also branded as Commas) offers a public API with embedded checkouts, multi-rail payouts, SDKs, and an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server capability for AI assistants.
